The 'Distinguishing features' checkpoint (ejection port) was also marked present, but upon close inspection, these features are often 'suggested' by shadow rather than clearly defined mechanical parts, which is a common AI artifact. However, since the gross morphology is correct, I will not downgrade the alignment score drastically, but I note the lack of fine mechanical fidelity.
artifact_review: The Router correctly identified the text gibberish and mounting hardware collapse. I am upgrading the severity of the background/mounting artifacts to reflect the logical failure of the scene grounding.
